notes.title: A new nightmare is on the horizon: Final Signature!
notes.content:
[h1][b]If You Haven't Forgotten the Gaze of Those Porcelain Eyes, We Invite You to a New Darkness[/b][/h1][p][/p][p]Dear Alessia's Dollhouse Community,[/p][p]First of all, we want to thank you all for accompanying Darren on his terrifying struggle that night and for braving the curse of the dollhouse with us. If you enjoyed the tension and helplessness you felt in those corridors, we are thrilled to announce that we're bringing you a brand new nightmare from SKYFOSTER: [b]Final Signature![/b][/p][p]This time, we're not inviting you to a dollhouse, but to the abandoned [b]De'Manor Hotel[/b], where time and memories have decayed, and terrible secrets are embedded in the walls. You are no longer a victim, but a contestant trying to solve mysteries alongside other competitors for a grand prize. But be warned, the other contestants are not the only danger in this hotel.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Your Signature Will Be Your Fate[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Final Signature[/b] is a survival horror experience that will throw you into a competition full of deception, challenge your psyche, and drive you to paranoia with every step. Solve the puzzles, uncover the hotel's cursed past, and most importantly, survive.[/p][p]Because at the end of the day, everyone will sign their fate. What will yours be?[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45065749/f60d5c211965b6957c5bde2888dad0c9a7b07181.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Join us on this new journey into fear! To get the latest information about [b]Final Signature[/b], follow its development, and be notified as soon as the game is released:[/p][p][b]Add Final Signature to your Steam Wishlist now![/b][/p][p]
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3600200/Final_Signature/?curator_clanid=26335619"][/dynamiclink][b] [/b][/p][p]Your support is our greatest strength in bringing this new nightmare to life.[/p][p]See you at the De'Manor Hotel...[/p][p][b]The SKYFOSTER & ALTERED GAMES Team[/b][/p]

notes.title: Alessia's Dollhouse Major Update
notes.content:
General Changes:

    Brightness Settings: The game's brightness settings have been adjusted.

    Difficulty Modes: Three difficulty modes have been added: Easy, Normal, and Hard.

Difficulty Mode Specific Changes:

    Easy Mode:

        Vex's speed has been reduced.

        Nina's speed has been reduced.

        Despawn time has been shortened.

        Spawn time has been lengthened.

    Normal Mode:

        Nina's speed has been decreased.

        Despawn time has been decreased.

    Hard Mode:

        Spawn times have been shortened.

        Nina's speed has been increased.

Other Changes:

    Translations: The game's translations have been updated.

    Horror Elements: Additional horror elements have been added to the game.

    Achievements: New achievements have been added that are tied to difficulty modes.

Information:

    New features are not active in old saves.

notes.title: Alessia's Dollhouse releases on July 10th!
notes.content:
[b][h1]Some Homes Hide a Nightmare That Never Sleeps...[/h1][/b]

Alessia's Dollhouse is a first-person psychological horror game that will take your breath away. In the dead of night, on a deserted road, you take on the role of Darren, an ordinary pizza delivery man in an eerie dollhouse full of sinister secrets. But this time your delivery address will drag you into a vortex of unimaginable horror.



[b][h1]ADD TO YOUR WISH LIST NOW!!![/h1][/b]
